newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Fire sweeps through Czech parliament annexe.
newsitem.headline: Fire sweeps through Czech parliament annexe.

text.p: Fire broke out in an annexe to the Czech parliament in a historic part of central Prague early on Thursday and two firemen were injured, the fire brigade said.

The blaze broke out early on Thursday in a former Jesuit monastery under reconstruction in the same street as the baroque parliament, said Vaclav Hladik, chief investigator for the Prague fire brigade.
The parliamentary annexe had not yet been occupied and no construction workers were on site when the fire started.
By morning, the fire had been brought under control. "We cannot estimate the cost of the damage yet, nor do we know the cause," Hladik told Reuters.

One of the two injured firemen had minor treatment but there were no immediate details of the other's condition. CTK news agency reported earlier that several firemen had been injured in the fire in a parliamentary building.
